design: five disjoint county groups; train other counties <=2017, test held counties 2018-2025
spatial_scope: internal Iowa county transfer; not independent field validation

features_removed.cdd: NOAA cooling degree days; NOT consecutive dry days
features_removed.gdd: seasonal mean approximation, not daily accumulated GDD
features_removed.heat_days_30c/35c: heuristic from seasonal mean maxima, not observed daily counts
features_removed.vpd_mean_kpa: heuristic temperature formula, not measured vapor pressure deficit

season: April-September, six months ending September; historical column names retained
provenance: Rebuilt from a newly downloaded full USDA CSV and 297 complete NOAA JSON responses; raw hashes verified; climate differences from frozen table disclosed
interpretation: Retrospective source-version robustness check, not a pristine independent validation or test-driven model selection
